description: This file defines classes and functions modeling devices, links, and network topology in a Multi-AP network simulation. It includes classes for Metric, Message, Network, Device, and Link, with methods for managing network topology, detecting loops, and calculating backhaul trees.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Models a collection of devices and links, with methods to add devices, create links, and calculate backhaul trees. Contains nested exception class LoopDetected for cycle detection.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents a device in the network, managing links, bridged links, and forwarding database. Provides methods to add links and retrieve neighbors.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: Models a bidirectional link between two devices with an associated metric. Ensures no self-links and provides method to get the other device.

classes.name: Metric
classes.description: Represents the quality of a link, currently modeled as bitrate in Mbps.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Models a network message with a type and payload.

methods.name: add_device
methods.description: Creates and adds a new device to the network, returning the device object.

methods.name: add_devices_with_links
methods.description: Creates multiple devices and connects each new device to existing devices with symmetrical links of specified metric.

methods.name: calculate_backhaul_tree
methods.description: Calculates the backhaul link tree from devices to the gateway, raising LoopDetected if a cycle is found.

methods.name: add_link
methods.description: Creates a link between this device and another device with a specified metric.

methods.name: neighbors
methods.description: Returns the set of neighboring devices connected via bridged links.

methods.name: other
methods.description: Returns the device on the other end of the link given one device.
